newsitem.title: USA: Pac Rim, Superior National revise merger.
newsitem.headline: Pac Rim, Superior National revise merger.

text.p: Pac Rim Holding Corp said on Tuesday it agreed to a restated definitive merger agreement with Superior National Insurance Group Inc, which adjusted downward the purchase price to $42 million cash from $54 million.
The company said the change is a result of an adjustment to increase the loss and loss adjustment expense reserves of Pac Rim's subsidiary, Pacific Rim Assurance Co, by $12 million.

Pac Rim, which writes workers' compensation insurance in California, Arizona, Texas, Georgia, and Alabama, said it expects to post its loss and loss adjustment expense reserves in its fourth-quarter results, which will lead the company to record a "significant loss" in its operating results for the fourth quarter and the year.

Under the revised terms, Superior will pay about $20 million, or $2.11 per share, to Pac Rim's common stockholders, $20 million to its convertible debenture holders, and about $1.96 million to the warrant and option holders.
The company said its Feb 26 special meeting will be postponed to April 8.

Superior National said in a separate statement that various Pac Rim stockholders and convertible debenture holders, accounting for about 50 percent of the outstanding voting rights, have agreed to vote in favor of the acquisition.
